description: Search published South African FSCA RE5 & RE1 Moonstone-style practice exam questions across Qualifying Criteria Tasks 1 to 8, including statutory references, correct answers, and trap rationales.

exam_scope.description: Optional exam track filter: RE5, RE1, or BOTH

limit.description: Maximum number of exam questions to return (default: 10, max: 20)

query.description: Optional keyword or statutory clause (e.g., 'debarment', 'FICA', 'immaterial', '15 days', 'Key Individual')

task_number.description: Optional FSCA Qualifying Criteria Task number from 1 to 8

traps_only.description: Set to true to return only Moonstone double-negative and number trap questions

name: search_exam_questions
